behavior.registry_revocation: All sessions for the immutable local account ID expire after a successful commit; rollback does not revoke.
behavior.per_request_validation: Local ID, username, enabled flag, role set and credential stamp must still match the database.
behavior.database_unavailable: 503 authentication_unavailable; no cached-privilege authorization and recoverable session retained.
behavior.external_identities: Login-time memberships; source-qualified manual revocation, active provider revision/disable checks and absolute expiry.
behavior.websocket: Explicit revocation and servlet destruction close connections; input and one-second scheduled checks revalidate sessions.
behavior.basic: Fresh password verification for explicit Basic headers; anonymous CLI CSRF cookies remain supported.
behavior.token_credentials: Independent scoped Bearer credentials retain their separate expiry/revocation policy.

verification_limits.external_ldap_oidc: Synthetic external principals and a stub authentication manager exercise registration and revocation; no live remote IdP.
verification_limits.websocket_transport: Focused decorator/servlet-event tests with mocked WebSocket transports; no native PTY/WebSocket end-to-end run.
verification_limits.chromium_ui: Attempted tools/verify-session-ui.py. Chromium could not start because the environment prohibits its Unix process-singleton socket (Operation not permitted). Browser interaction checks are not claimed.
verification_limits.ui_other_checks: Real server-rendered user pages and mutations passed; configuration JavaScript syntax checked with node --check.
verification_limits.docker_runtime: Not run for issue #22. Earlier scanner/Compose/native-engine results retain their original scope.
verification_limits.external_sql: H2 used for current tests. Existing external SQL schema/probe tests run in Maven; no new live external database run.
verification_limits.deployment_scope: Registry/manual revocation is per instance; direct local database state checks work for each instance sharing that database. No supported distributed session cluster.
verification_limits.remote_groups: Remote membership removal is not pushed automatically: remove IdP access and revoke each instance, or wait for absolute expiry/relogin.
verification_limits.in_flight_work: A request already executing when an account change commits is not retroactively undone.
